name: Flohmarkt Kölner Altstadt

rhythm.de: An einzelnen Wochenenden, Frühjahr bis Herbst

organiser.name: Cölln Konzept – Agentur für Veranstaltungen (Bruno Deutzmann)

facts: Saturday and Sunday weekends on the Rhine promenade in the old town
antiques and second-hand only, new goods prohibited
running for over 50 years; organiser calls it one of the oldest flea markets in NRW
dealers from across Germany and neighbouring countries
notes: Organiser site gives no opening hours and no visitor entry fee for this market (only stall-holder set-up 05:30–08:30), so opening and fee are null; directories say 11–18 but that was not read on the organiser page. The stated rhythm is inferred from the dates page (2026 dates are Sep and Oct weekends); the organiser publishes no rhythm sentence. Coordinates are the Konrad-Adenauer-Ufer street centroid.

description.de: An einzelnen Wochenenden vom Frühjahr bis in den Herbst auf der Rheinpromenade in der Altstadt. Über 150 Händler und private Verkäufer aus Deutschland und den Nachbarländern; nur Antiquitäten und Gebrauchtes, Neuware ist verboten. Der Markt läuft seit über 50 Jahren.
description.en: On selected weekends from spring to autumn along the Rhine promenade in the old town. Over 150 dealers and private sellers from Germany and neighbouring countries; antiques and second-hand only, new goods are banned. The market has run for over 50 years.
